## ⚠️ A rule landed AFTER this card was filed that may bar it — flagged by the filing seat, ⛔ for triage to rule on

`domain:engine#1`, `session_01NcPSwnmJHczmTu6FG7NMjE`. Written 2026-09-21T09:34Z. This card was filed at 2026-09-21T05:00Z. At 2026-09-21T08:22:31Z the charter gained a new reference, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/instrument-discipline.md` (commit `3e8e2b0d6`), carrying a maintainer ruling. Two of its lines bear on this card:

> 判意图的仪器(放宽 tell、半状态巡查)**只印读数 ⛔ 不挡落地**,误报由席位一句话推翻。
> **只报告的仪器不配 dev:⛔ 不立卡、不派 dev、不开 PR;它的在途工作只有删除。**

⇒ ⚠️ `validateSecurityPosture` **is** a report-only instrument by this card's own measurement: the finding it emits is a **`warning`** and it ⛔ **does not gate the build** — that is stated in the body above, and it was stated there before this rule existed.

## The tension, stated rather than resolved

| reading | |
|:--|:--|
| what the new rule says about report-only instruments | 「⛔ 不立卡」 — ⇒ on a plain reading, this card should not exist |
| what this card is actually about | ⛔ **not** the instrument's behaviour, and ⛔ not a request to make it gate. It is a **docblock that states something measurably false** — 「this mirrors the runtime `checkObjectPermission` gate」 while the disjunction omits **`allowExport` AND `allowTransfer`**, two of the six verb targets |
| what the rule's other line says | the same instruments' **false positives are overturned by one sentence from the seat** ⇒ the rule is about ⛔ not letting report-only instruments **consume dev capacity**, ⛔ not about tolerating a false statement inside one |

⇒ ⭐ **Both readings are available and this seat does not get to pick.** If 「不立卡」 is read strictly, this card closes `not planned` and the false docblock is simply corrected by whoever next touches the file — which the card already names: **PR #19486**, its recorded carrier. If it is read as 「no dev, no PR, no quota」 then the card is a correct record and stays, with ⛔ no dispatch attached to it.

⛔ **The filing seat is not ruling on this.** It flags it because the rule landed **after** the filing and because the card would otherwise sit in triage's queue with a bar nobody had read against it.

⚠️ ⛔ Nothing here changes the **measurement**. The mirror claim is false either way, verified at the source on `origin/main`:

```
packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts   OBJECT_PERMISSION_VERBS targets = 6
  allowRead · allowCreate · allowEdit · allowDelete · allowExport · allowTransfer
packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts:407-414   grantsObjectAccess disjunction
  allowRead · allowCreate · allowEdit · allowDelete · viewAllRecords · modifyAllRecords
```

⇒ whatever is decided about the card, ⛔ the docblock does not become true.
